Found the US-60 x CR8 intersection via OSM/Overpass (shared node 34.8509863,-102.3239961 between way US-60 and way County Road 8), then walked 2.6 mi EAST along CR8's own road geometry (haversine cumulative distance along real vertices, not a straight bearing) -> 34.84993,-102.27918. Not a county centroid — a named-road-intersection + on-road-distance derivation.
site.cross_checks: OSM power=substation sweep near Hereford TX found real, named 345kV 'Windmill Substation' (34.77338,-102.30455) and 'Hereford Wind Substation' (34.77308,-102.29813), ~5.4-5.5 mi south of the candidate — confirms the AJ Swope-Windmill 345kV corridor named in the IA actually exists in this area. No OSM node literally named 'AJ Swope' or 'Mule Deer Switch' (expected: Mule Deer is a NEW, not-yet-built tap per the IA, so not yet mapped). This corroborates the transmission corridor, not a direct pin on the switch itself — hence medium not high confidence.

reasoning_evidence: queue_history.py timeline.md (72 monthly snapshots, 2020-07 -> 2026-06): the queue's OWN reported COD held at 2025-08-28 from 2023-02 through 2025-03 (25 months) — EXACTLY matching the signed IA's Scheduled Commercial Operation Date (Exhibit E). This confirms the queue and IA were tracking the same schedule, i.e. the project genuinely targeted Aug-2025. The queue COD then slipped to 2026-10-10 (as of Apr-2025 snapshot, i.e. AFTER the original date had already passed with no construction) and again to 2027-10-15/2027-10-26 (from Feb-2026) — both post-hoc slips with NO corresponding IA amendment on file (puct.py match re-checked twice, by INR and by 'CIG DS1' key — both return only the single original filing 35077-1688).

The project therefore missed its own signed, once-confirmed COD (2025-08-28) by ~11 months as of today (2026-07-20) and shows ZERO imagery evidence of construction as of the most recent clear pass (2026-05-19) — 9+ months after that missed date. The two post-hoc slips (to 2026-10, then 2027-10) read as the developer/TSP informally re-forecasting without ever amending the binding IA — a soft, undocumented slip pattern rather than a renegotiated contractual schedule.

factsheet.json corroborates from the queue side: 5 total COD slips since ~2020, fisApproved still null as of the last snapshot, not in EIA-860M despite the (at-the-time) claimed COD being <18 months out — three independent signals (missed IA date, queue instability, EIA absence) all point the same direction.

No Ch.313/JETI filing, no CAD parcel record obtained, no press/PR, no construction-stormwater NOI, no financing announcement beyond CIG's own marketing — a limited paper trail for a project this size (406.6 MW, ~$13M LC posted) this far past its original target date.

The reported 2027-10-26 COD cannot be verified as a credible near-term target given zero physical progress at the derived site as of 2026-05-19 — treat as a re-forecast, not a grounded date. If construction has not started by early 2027, an 18-24 month solar build timeline alone makes 2027-10-26 very unlikely; a realistic floor is 2028 or later, with genuine uncertainty whether the project proceeds in its current form at all (CIG's own site described it as 'permitting stage' as of an Oct-2024 update).
